description: SDPA forward in the ASM_SDPA_ENGINE region: bfloat16, head size 128 or 192 for Q and K with V and O at 128 (fmha_v3_fwd gfx942/gfx950 kernel tables), BSHD or BHSD, grouped-query heads, any sequence length, dense or bottom-right causal. gfx950 ships no causal kernel, so its causal samples decline; they stay as probes. The domain axis fills Q, K and V; large uses scale 8 instead of 32 so Q.K sums of a 192-wide head stay inside the half and bfloat16 range before the softmax scale. The nan and inf domains put the special fill on V alone and leave Q and K at free(-1,1): a non-finite Q or K element spreads over a whole softmax row, while one in V reaches only its own head-dim column of the output; no operand is elementwise-local, so most samples with a long kv sequence turn every output element non-finite and fail the non-finite mask by design.

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*dqk, dqk, hq*dqk, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dqk, sq*dqk, dqk, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*hkv*dqk, dqk, hkv*dqk, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dqk, skv*dqk, dqk, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*hkv*dv, dv, hkv*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dv, skv*dv, dv, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*hq*dv, dv, hq*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dv, sq*dv, dv, 1]
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if domain in ['nan', 'inf'] else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))

constraints.reason: bottom-right causal mask needs sq <= skv
